objective: Verify in the candidate Ascend-C source that the migrated shiftPitchLinear routine copies each selected source binary32 word to the output without any payload-altering operation, so the item's special values 0x00000001 (smallest positive subnormal) and 0x80000000 (-0.0) cannot be canonicalized before storage.
observation: The candidate source text of the migrated routine: the source-load expression, the output-store expression, and every operation interposed between loading the selected source element and storing the output element.
pass_condition: Accept iff the output store assigns the exact 32-bit word loaded from the source element, with integer arithmetic allowed only for source-index computation and no floating-point arithmetic, rounding, normalization, comparison, or type conversion applied to the payload word between load and store. Reject if any payload-altering operation appears, since it could flush 0x00000001 to 0x00000000 or collapse 0x80000000 to 0x00000000.
setup: Locate the candidate Ascend-C artifact implementing the shiftPitchLinear-equivalent kernel/operator. Identify (a) the expression that computes the source index and (b) the expression that stores O[y*P+x] for each logical output coordinate (x,y).
